objective: Determine which point-in-time USD calibration evidence actually existed across the nine reviewed historical Sentry implementation representatives, then define a separate historical baseline policy only if the evidence supports one without changing current R3 semantics.
preregistered_hypotheses: H1: the historical WETH/USDT0 calibration route exists but lacks executable depth for one or more frozen R1 notionals at many decision blocks.
H2: one or more historical epochs lack the required WETH/USDT0 calibration pool or token/code surface entirely.
H3: full R1 calibration becomes available only after a later point-in-time infrastructure/liquidity transition, making current R1 semantics non-portable to earlier launches.
decision_rules: If the exact historical calibration route is executable for all frozen notionals and the prior failure is caused by the compatibility adapter, repair the adapter without changing EXECUTABLE_BASELINE_R1 semantics.
If the point-in-time WETH/USDT0 route is genuinely absent or too shallow, do not shrink notionals post hoc and do not reinterpret EXECUTABLE_BASELINE_R1 to force coverage.

If R1 is genuinely non-portable, any successor historical policy must use only information available at the decision block, must be versioned separately from EXECUTABLE_BASELINE_R1, and must be preregistered before any 147-launch replay.
Do not use future prices, retrospective centralized-exchange prices, outcome-conditioned sizing, or per-token adaptive notionals to rescue failed historical launches.
prohibitions: Do not change current R3 baseline semantics or authority.
Do not modify the five frozen EXECUTABLE_BASELINE_R1 notionals in this discovery gate.
Do not authorize or run the full 147-launch replay.
Do not add signing, approvals, swap construction, transaction broadcast, private keys, or execution authority.
Do not use future or retrospective off-chain prices as point-in-time evidence.
Do not merge without explicit user authority.
notes: The user explicitly authorized the HISTORICAL_BASELINE_POLICY_R1 successor after HISTORICAL_COMPATIBILITY_R1 stopped on frozen baseline semantics.
This authorization covers the bounded successor phase; discovery is intentionally first because a valid historical policy cannot be selected before observing the point-in-time calibration surface.
Discovery completion does not self-authorize replay, FAST_VET, canary, merge, signing, or execution.
